dialogues.speaker: Henry Morton
dialogues.text: I thought so too, and I did remember that you could charter one at Dornman Port, but that's way too far away.

dialogues.speaker: Henry Morton
dialogues.text: Who knows how long a round trip will take, either...

dialogues.speaker: Henry Morton
dialogues.text: But I couldn't possibly construct my own boat. I mean, I learned nothing about that in the Akademiya...
